name: Transcript to SRT/VTT subtitles
Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
description: Split a transcript you already have into timed SRT, WebVTT or text cues. Timing is estimated from word count and labelled as such.

seo.metaTitle: Transcript to SRT/VTT subtitles — free in your browser, no upload | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Convert a transcript into SRT or WebVTT subtitle cues with estimated timing, in your browser tab. No audio upload, no speech model, no account.
seo.aeoSummary: This tool converts a typed transcript into timed subtitle cues inside your browser tab. Timing is derived from word count at your chosen speaking rate and marked as an estimate; it does not transcribe audio and never uploads anything.

faqs.question: Does this tool upload my files my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. It does not process audio at all — it formats a transcript you paste, so there is no audio to upload and no speech model to download.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Speech-to-text & audio transcriber?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/voice_transcribe.json or open /tools/voice-transcribe?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.

steps: Paste or load your text data directly into the input editor.
Apply transformations, formatting, or validation rules in real time.

task: Turn a transcript into timed subtitles
desc: Splits a transcript you already have into SRT, WebVTT or plain-text cues at a chosen words-per-minute and cue length. Timing is estimated from word count and labelled as an estimate — this tool does not listen to audio.
